Subject: Trial access & PO timeline

Hi Hannah,

Quick follow-up — your team indicated procurement would submit a PO for the pilot. Our current trial window for your team expires in ~72 hours (May 4). Can you share the expected PO ETA so we can avoid any interruption for the engineering team?

If the PO will be delayed by more than a few business days, would you like me to request a short extension on your trial while procurement completes internal approvals? Happy to propose options.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Subject: Re: Trial access & PO timeline

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for checking in. Unfortunately procurement hit a snag with a routing approval — the PO will likely be delayed. Best estimate from our side is that we can get a PO signed and over to you by Monday, May 10.

The engineering team is actively evaluating Redwood and we don’t want the trial window to lapse. Can you extend the trial for ~2 weeks so we don’t lose access while procurement finishes? Also, as part of internal justification, would Redwood consider a small promotional credit (we were hoping for ~50k tokens) so we can run the final benchmark suite before the PO is issued. I attached a short note from procurement that explains the approval steps they require.

Appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Hannah Lee
Senior Procurement Specialist, Acme Apps
hannah.lee@acme-apps.com

Good news: we can extend your trial by 14 calendar days (so access will be preserved through May 24) and we'll provide a one-time 25,000 token promotional credit to help run your final benchmarks. We've attached a short confirmation PDF for your records.

If procurement can send the PO earlier than May 10, that will help us expedite quota increases and any additional credits. For the extra 25k tokens you requested, I'm happy to revisit that once the PO is in-hand — if procurement can commit to a PO date we can sign off on additional promotional support quickly.

Next steps for you: please confirm you received this and I will mark the extension and credit on our side. If you want Marissa to schedule a short onboarding call to accelerate benchmark runs, let me know and she can reach out.
